hints.title: Collection Time Partition
hints.text: Every piece of garbage takes one minute to collect regardless of truck or house, so the total collection time equals the total count of characters across all houses.

hints.title: Furthest House Index
hints.text: For each garbage type ('M', 'P', 'G'), identify the last house index that contains that specific type.

hints.title: Travel Cost Prefix
hints.text: Compute cumulative travel times so the total travel cost for each truck is simply the prefix travel sum up to its furthest house.

hints.title: Garbage Collection Calculation Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear scan across garbage strings and travel array.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating separate truck movements step-by-step causes redundant iterations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix travel array enables constant-time retrieval of travel sums.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decomposes total time into total item counts plus travel distance up to maximum occurrence.
